# 研究文档模板 / Research Document Templates

将所需模板复制到课题目录，再填写对应章节。
Copy the templates you need into your project and fill in the relevant sections.

| 模板 / Template | 用途 / Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [课题说明 / Project overview](project-readme.md) | 研究问题、范围与目录导航 / Research question, scope, and navigation |
| [研究计划 / Research plan](research-plan.md) | 目标、方法和里程碑 / Objectives, methods, and milestones |
| [实验记录 / Experiment log](experiment-log.md) | 设置、步骤与观察 / Setup, procedure, and observations |
| [论文提纲 / Paper outline](paper-outline.md) | 文章结构和参考文献 / Manuscript structure and references |
